channel_partner_growth_strategy_2026_10_.intended_cap_interpretation: After establishing a real demonstration base and operating capability, stop self-operated device headcount growth around 50; expand via independent data-delivery partners.
channel_partner_growth_strategy_2026_10_.rationale: Own-site training/showcase, demonstrable real audit and settlement, standardised operations, reputational trust in partners
channel_partner_growth_strategy_2026_10_.partner_role: only with explicit upstream authorization, partners fulfil capture tasks using their independently organised lawful people/scenes/equipment and return approved data
channel_partner_growth_strategy_2026_10_.gate: no redistribution before upstream written subcontracting/third-party data processing/device-account permissions, contract and finance review; no assumption 50 owned devices or franchise compliance already achieved

current_approved_owner_growth_strategy_2.self_operated_goal: Fix 10 owned/leased operating stations as production, on-site training and showcase; stop expanding own sites and direct collector headcount after these are stable
